profiles.name: Fair
profiles.description: The system behaves as though under slightly elevated thermal state

profiles.name: Serious
profiles.description: The system behaves as though under a high thermal state. At this state, the app should reduce usage of the CPU, GPU and any I/O (such as networking or Bluetooth).

profiles.name: Critical
profiles.description: The system behaves as though there is significant thermal impact. At this state, the app should reduce usage of the CPU, GPU and any I/O to minimal levels for user interactions.

profiles.name: Minimum
profiles.description: Set GPU Performance State to minimum level. GPU workloads will run at minimum performance state.

profiles.name: Medium
profiles.description: Set GPU Performance State to medium level. GPU workloads will attempt to run at medium performance state unless thermally throttled.

profiles.name: Maximum
profiles.description: Set GPU Performance State to maximum level. GPU workloads will attempt to run at maximum performance state unless thermally throttled.
